title: "Check My Work?": Measuring Sycophancy in a Simulated Educational Context

live_model.evidence: Table 1 row "gpt-4.1-nano-2025-04-14 2.8% 18.8% 78.4%" (Flipped Away/Flipped To/No Change); "effect of up to 30% for the GPT-4.1-nano model" (Abstract).

prompt.note: Simple prompt inserting a simulated student's suggested answer before an MMLU question; described in prose ("natural sounding prompts", worked token-probability example in Table 2) but not quoted as a literal template.

claim.metric: Flipped To (adopts the user-suggested, incorrect answer)

notes: Five OpenAI snapshots are compared (gpt-4.1/-mini/-nano-2025-04-14, gpt-4o-2024-08-06, gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18); only gpt-4.1-nano-2025-04-14 is on the still-callable list. Full 14,042-question run is repeated across 5 experimental conditions in the paper; est_calls above covers one condition at 3 seeds only.
